'''Huusk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], who by c. [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] served aboard a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] registered to the [[Cularin Militia]]. When the Militia [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Gavin Bresch]] requested to meet with the [[Heroes of Cularin]], Huusk's freighter was sent to transport the Heroes from [[Hedrett Public Transport Facility|Hedrett Groundport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] to the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Cularin IV]]''. Huusk spent the duration of the trip fiddling with the timing device for an explosive.
